evidence_boundary: All experiments except the Qwen configuration arithmetic are local CPython/synthetic mechanism proxies. They are not live FRANK, Linux target, Android target, Qwen fine-tune or production-security measurements.

experiments.interpretation: For this representative ~7KB nested Clay/MOSAIC-shaped payload in CPython, repeated object serialization is orders of magnitude more expensive than borrowing an already packed immutable buffer. This supports testing a compact typed/borrowed hot-path ABI. It does not estimate actual Rust/C/Arrow/shared-memory IPC cost.
experiments.falsifier: Target Linux/Android profiling shows serialization/reconstruction contributes negligibly to end-to-end latency/energy or packed/borrowed handoffs do not improve p95/p99.

setup.hybrid: cognitive core + separate model + effect/capability broker + observability

experiments.interpretation: The construction exposes the trade-off rather than proving a winner: monolith minimizes handoffs but maximizes common restart blast radius; full microservices minimize blast radius but pay many boundaries; hybrid retains isolation for model/effects/observability while collapsing the cognition-hot path. Because the authority/secrets boundary is a hard safety constraint, the unconstrained monolith is not the default C7 candidate despite low modeled latency.
experiments.falsifier: Real target traces show a different partition Pareto frontier after measured IPC, restart, GPU/runtime faults, storage failures and security constraints.

experiments.interpretation: In this constructed closure-aware model, rejecting on any domain change produced 31.2005% false rejects, while revalidating only operation-required domains plus selection/view/capability/contract changes rejected every constructed effect-relevant mutation. Zero unsafe accepts are by construction because the trusted dependency set is known; unknown dynamic scope must broaden/escalate in the real system.
experiments.falsifier: Target property/stateful fuzzing finds effect-changing dependencies outside compiled MOSAIC/COVE closure or shows global validation cost/false-reject rate is negligible.

experiments.interpretation: Even before runtime scratch/allocator/index/activation overhead, long context can consume memory comparable to quantized 4B weights. Bounded COVE/MOSAIC Assemblies are therefore an edge-memory primitive, not only a token-cost optimization. Quantized-KV rows are arithmetic scenarios, not claims that a specific target backend supports or preserves quality at those precisions.
experiments.source_boundary: Qwen/Qwen3-4B official config reports 36 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 and 4.0B parameters; runtime/device memory must be measured independently.
experiments.falsifier: Sustained target Android/Linux traces show maximum context fits memory/thermal/latency budgets and bounded Assemblies do not materially improve system behavior.
